docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Charles Wilkins' English Hitopadeśa, the first translation of the tales of the animals and their counsel to princes, in the reprint of 1886 introduced by Henry Morley.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Fables and proverbs from the Sanskrit, being the Hitopadesa; · Wilkins, Charles, Sir, 1750-1836 · 1886, 296 scanned pages. Published 1886 (translation first printed 1787); Charles Wilkins died 1836 and Henry Morley, who introduced this edition, 1894; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
